title: Predictive Assistance and the Temporal Dynamics of Exploratory Compression
abstract: arXiv:2606.10094v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Classical theories of cognition describe problem solving as exploratory search through structured problem spaces in which repeated interaction gradually compresses search into efficient representational structures. Predictive artificial intelligence systems introduce a distinct regime in which stabilization may occur before exploratory diversification unfolds, supplying solutions and decision trajectories prior to internally generated search. This paper develops a geometric dynamical framework in which attention evolves over a landscape of strategies shaped by stabilizing drift, endogenous exploratory perturbation, and responsiveness-gated learning. Predictive assistance is modeled as a process of exogenous exploratory compression that stabilizes trajectories before self-generated exploration broadens the accessible regions of strategy space. translated_title: 预测性辅助与探索性压缩的时间动力学
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.10094v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：经典的认知理论将问题解决描述为在结构化问题空间中的探索性搜索，其中重复的交互逐渐将搜索压缩为高效的表征结构。预测性人工智能系统引入了一种独特的机制：稳定化可能在探索性多样化展开之前发生，在内部生成的搜索开始之前就提供解决方案和决策轨迹。本文开发了一个几何动力学框架，其中注意力在一个由稳定化漂移、内生探索性扰动和响应性门控学习共同塑造的策略景观上演化。预测性辅助被建模为一种外源性探索性压缩过程，即在自我生成的探索拓宽策略空间的可达区域之前，轨迹已被稳定化。该框架产生了三个主要结果。首先，持续的预测性稳定化减少了……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出一个几何动力学框架，将预测性AI辅助建模为“外源性探索性压缩”——它在个体自发的探索性多样化展开之前就稳定了问题求解的轨迹，从而在理论上刻画了预测辅助系统如何改变认知搜索的时间动态。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a geometric dynamical framework modeling predictive AI assistance as "exogenous exploratory compression" that stabilizes problem-solving trajectories before self-generated exploration can diversify, theoretically characterizing how predictive systems reshape the temporal dynamics of cognitive search.
